title: GTA6 Fan Upgrades Gaming Setup With Custom Vice City Neon Sign
description: A GTA6 fan shares their custom Vice City neon sign setup on Reddit, inspired by the Kaseya Center logo, showcasing the community's anticipation.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Community Hype Builds as Players Upgrade Setups for GTA6

As anticipation for Rockstar Games' upcoming title continues to grow across the globe, the r/GTA6 Reddit community remains a hub for passionate fans sharing their preparations. Recently, a community member under the username u/Shade28032006 posted about a recent hardware and room upgrade featuring a custom Vice City neon sign. (Note: This information comes from a community submission and represents personal player activity rather than official announcements.)

## Inspired by Real-World Aesthetics

According to the user, the neon sign's design was directly inspired by the iconic Vice City logo seen at the Kaseya Center in Miami. Given that GTA6 returns players to the vibrant, neon-soaked streets of a modern-day Vice City, the aesthetic choice is a fitting tribute to the game's setting. While the user noted that the custom sign "wasn't exactly cheap," they firmly stated that the investment was "definitely worth it" for the atmosphere it brings to their gaming space.

Hardware upgrades, themed room decor, and custom builds have long been a staple of the passionate fanbase surrounding major franchise releases. Even amidst periods of limited official updates from developers, community-driven content highlights the deep connection players feel toward the virtual world of Vice City.

## Editor's Take

Seeing fans go to such creative lengths to prepare their gaming spaces for GTA6 highlights the incredible cultural footprint of the franchise. While it is simply a personal setup showcase, it captures the genuine excitement driving the community forward while we await the game's release.
